The perfect restaurant to try good, authentic Vietnamese food.

My Order:
- 1 x Vietnamese Grilled Lemongrass
- Price: 145K
- Rating: 5/5

- Price: 520K
- Rating: 5/5

The prices are a little higher than some of the other restaurants in Da Nang, but your paying for the service, food and ambience.

Overall Rating: 5/5

Although the seats weren’t comfortable, the service and food was great, hence my overall rating.

There is a Michelin, just search for it.
Sep 2026 • Couples
I would write it like this—calmly, without rudeness, but so that the reasons for disappointment are clear:

Today we visited this restaurant, which is listed in the Michelin guide. For us, this is the second restaurant with such a recommendation in Vietnam, so expectations were, of course, quite high. Unfortunately, the impressions here were quite mixed.

The first thing that surprised me was the absence of regular paper napkins on the table. The guest is given one small wet wipe for the entire dinner. Maybe it's a small thing, but it looks a bit strange for a restaurant of this level.

I ordered one of my favorite Vietnamese salads - with mango and seafood. In the last month, I tried it in many places, so I already have a good idea of what it can taste like and what it contains. At my request, they added spiciness here - thank you to the staff. But the portion itself was quite small, there was very little seafood, and of the vegetables, only mango was almost noticeable: there was very little carrot and onion. In the end, the salad lacked a bit of textural variety and richness, in my opinion.

The menu itself also seemed quite limited: for example, we didn't find any mussels or scallops, although we expected a wider selection of seafood. At the same time, the prices are quite high, and personally, we were left with the feeling that the ratio of price, portion size, and the impression of the dishes did not quite meet expectations.

At the same time, the restaurant is very popular, there are really many guests, the staff was polite, so maybe it's just not our place and other guests will have completely different impressions. But personally, we probably won't come here a second time.

If you want, I can make it a little harsher and for a confident 2 stars or, conversely, softer for 3 stars, so the review looks as correct as possible.

Must return
Jul 2026 • Family
We visited Bep Cuon as a family on 21 July and had a wonderful dining experience.

Since we had booked a table in advance, we did not have to wait, which was great because the restaurant was completely full when we arrived.

We ordered a Chicken Pho and a set meal, which came with a large bottle of drink. A special thank you to our waitress, Vii, who provided exceptional service throughout our meal. She thoughtfully separated the ice from the drink so that our children could enjoy it without the ice, which was very considerate.

Vii also patiently demonstrated how to wrap the ingredients properly, making the experience even more enjoyable for us. Her attentiveness and friendly attitude were definitely the highlight of our visit.

The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and the prices were very reasonable. We felt that the restaurant offered outstanding value for money.

Overall, it is easy to see why Bep Cuon has earned Michelin recognition. It is truly well-deserved, and we would happily recommend it to others. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
